style: Create a fresh readable high-fidelity Rillora landing-page SECTION design at desktop 1440px wide. The owner says the current page feels chopped into separate pages, has too little useful content, and needs substantially richer motion. Redesign the body as ONE CONTINUOUS warm-paper #F5F1E8 canvas. Deep-forest #23473D type, subtle bronze #BD9473 connection traces, quiet photographic green-cloth folio language from the references. Source Serif4 display with Inter controls. No alternating full-width dark/light blocks, no boxed bento grids, no repeated header per section, no large gaps that sever the story. Use thin rules, recurring left gutter step numbers and related product scenes to connect sections. More information should come from real interactive examples, not paragraphs. The APPROVED full fingerprint-tree mark remains unchanged. This is a software product, not physical stationery for sale. Any screenshots/fields are synthetic examples. Specific Apple/Google/Binance/Coinbase operation guides must NOT appear on the public page; they move after login. No fake metrics/testimonials/certifications/E2EE claim, no automatic death/inactivity release, no passwords/private keys. Top account entry elsewhere says Preview and goes to the test app. This section must integrate naturally into the same continuous page.
